    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Account
    Represents a user account with authentication credentials, a monetary balance, and an associated AccountConfig (theme, currency, avatar).
    AccountConfig
    Stores user preference settings for an Account: avatar image path, color theme mode (DARK / LIGHT), and currency (USD / EUR / EGP).
    AccountManager
    Handles authenticated account CRUD operations.
    App
    Main JavaFX Application class.
    AppAuth
    Default authentication strategy backed by LocalStorage.
    ApplicationState
    Singleton that owns the primary model managers (TransactionManager, BudgetManager, SavingGoalsManager, AccountManager) and coordinates event propagation across the application.
    AppSettings
    Holds all shared enumerations used throughout the application: data persistence keys, theme mode, currency, transaction type, operation result messages, and PropertyChangeEvent types for budgets, goals, accounts, and transactions.

    Budget
    Represents a budget for a specific category within a date period.
    BudgetController
    FXML controller for the Budgets screen.
    BudgetController.BudgetCategory
    Represents a single budget category with name, spent amount, limit, and an SVG icon path for display.
    BudgetManager
    Manages all Budget objects for the application.
    CurrencyUtil
    Utility class with static methods for currency formatting, symbol lookup, and conversion between supported currencies (USD, EUR, EGP).
    DashboardController
    FXML controller for the Dashboard screen.
    DialogHelper
    Utility class with static methods for constructing and displaying modal dialogs.
    EncryptionUtil
    Utility class for AES encryption and decryption.

    FXML controller for a single saving goal card.
    GoalsController
    FXML controller for the Goals screen.

    Login

    LoginController
    FXML controller for the Login screen.
    PDFReport
    Generates a PDF financial report.
    Period
    Represents a time period defined by a start and end LocalDate.
    ProfileController
    FXML controller for the Profile / Settings screen.
    Range
    Represents a numeric range between a minimum and maximum float value.
    Recognition
    Abstract template for authentication workflows.
    ReportConfig
    Holds configuration for a single report entry associating a category name with a calculated percentage value.
    ReportGenerator
    Interface for generating financial reports from transaction data.
    ReportsController
    FXML controller for the Reports screen.

    FXML controller for the user registration screen.

    TransactionConfig

    Manages all Transaction objects for the application.
    TransactionsController
    FXML controller for the Transactions screen.
    TransactionsController.DisplayTransaction
    Lightweight DTO(Display Transaction Object) representing a single transaction row for the UI.
